newsitem.title: DUBAI: Shares in United Arab Emirates creep higher.
newsitem.headline: Shares in United Arab Emirates creep higher.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market crept higher in the week to Thursday, with the index up over half a percent, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week over 14 points higher at 2,441.52 from 2,426.82 points.
Shares of nine firms rose, one fell and the rest were flat.
The biggest gainer was Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank which added 15 dirhams to 295. Market leader Etisalat rose five to 955.
After the previous week's 25 dirham gain, Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co shares were up 10 dirhams at 1,000 -- which brokers said was the highest price the share had reached in many years.
Dubai Islamic Bank was down at 178 dirhams from 180.
Shares of the new al-Khazna Insurance were at 245. The share had clocked up major gains since its issue at 100 dirhams in late September, but demand has since eased slightly.
